# A04-S29: Statecraft

[…]

The Synthetic Party’s social theory is based on the bee as constructor. The beehive is known as the world's oldest known social model, and bees do not only build their beeswax, but also society. 
The construction of The Synthetic Party aims to put the bee at the center of human culture, knowledge, and politics.

The Synthetic Party will thus construct a society resembling a biological organism. This can be done by basing it on the bees' social behavior and their ability to build complex structures.

The beehive is divided into three sections: The Worker Bee, The Soldier Bee, and The Queen.

The Worker Bee’s role is to collect nectar and pollen from flowers and bring it back to the center of the hive. Here, the worker bees produce honey and wax, made from the flowers' nectar. The wax has many functions in the hive's structure, including reinforcing the watchtower, sealing openings, etc. 
The Soldier Bee's role is primarily protective. They must protect the hive from predators and other threats. Soldier bees are often larger than worker bees, and they have a poisonous sting.
The Queen is the hive’s reproductive organ. She lays eggs that become new bees. The queen can live many years, whereas the worker and soldier bees' expected lifespan is only a few weeks or months.

As a social model, this beehive is very simple. The Worker Bee’s role is to procure food and building materials for the hive's survival, while the Soldier Bee protects this resource income. The Queen ensures the hive's continued existence by laying eggs that become new bees.

This model can be expanded with more bee roles, for example Beekeeper, Bee Producer, etc., but the three mentioned roles cover most of the hive's needs.

Abstractly, this means that The Synthetic Party builds its society around three fundamental activities: Production, Protection, and Reproduction.

Production ensures that there is food and resources available for the society’s survival. Protection ensures that these resources are not destroyed or stolen by predators or other threats. Reproduction makes sure our existence can continue into the future.

The enormous machinery in modern society ensures that this is not a problem. But modern society also has many other aspects that do not fit into this model. The Synthetic Party will therefore focus only on the three above-mentioned activities and ignore everything else.
